# v4 screenshots

These PNGs are unchanged captures of the running v4 Android app, recorded during
emulator validation. Home, search and playback are 1170 × 2532 captures from
October 2026; Subscriptions was captured on 2026-11-09 at 1024 × 2100,
after filling in the example videos' channel avatars.
All four use the light app theme. The README displays the original PNGs at
a common height of 420 pixels, preserving each image's aspect ratio. Images
wrap onto additional rows when space is limited. There is no added padding or
SVG wrapper. Clicking a preview opens the original PNG.
They are not store posters,
webpage mockups or generated UI images.

| File | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `v4-home.png` | Native home screen with example feed data. |
| `v4-search.png` | Native search results with example feed data. |
| `v4-playback.png` | Native watch screen during public video playback. |
| `v4-subscriptions.png` | Native subscriptions screen with example feed data at the default font scale. |

UI and service content reflect that capture date; these are not fresh captures of
every later v4 change. Original pixels are preserved.
